changeSet.author: zakaria el kotb
changeSet.sql: create table nomenclature ( id uuid not null, name varchar(255) not null unique, description varchar(500), nomenclature_definition_id uuid not null, definition_depth integer not null, status varchar(20) not null check (status in ('DRAFT','FIXED','ARCHIVED')), fixed_at timestamp(6) with time zone, fixed_by varchar(255), primary key (id) );
alter table nomenclature add constraint fk_nomenclature_definition foreign key (nomenclature_definition_id) references nomenclature_definition (id);

rollback.sql: drop table if exists nomenclature cascade;

changeSet.author: zakaria el kotb
changeSet.sql: create table nomenclature_rubrique ( id uuid not null, nomenclature_id uuid not null, parent_id uuid, level_position integer not null, code varchar(50) not null, label varchar(255) not null, leaf boolean not null, primary key (id), constraint uk_rubrique_nomenclature_code unique (nomenclature_id, code) );
alter table nomenclature_rubrique add constraint fk_rubrique_nomenclature foreign key (nomenclature_id) references nomenclature (id);
alter table nomenclature_rubrique add constraint fk_rubrique_parent foreign key (parent_id) references nomenclature_rubrique (id);

rollback.sql: drop table if exists nomenclature_rubrique cascade;
